objective: Advance AV-TRACE from audited real-A/V engineering and learned-retrieval diagnostics to a human-valid, source-disjoint Acquire/Ground/Act study with competent learned systems and paper-grade evidence.
global_prohibitions: Do not reuse old authorization receipts, nonces, attempt markers, or plan hashes after migration.
Do not rerun or reinterpret R22; its permanent decision is R22_SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO_PERMANENT_R23_REQUIRED.
Do not distribute blank Pilot-v4 packets as real human-review packets.
Do not expose untouched test semantics during source recovery, model competence work, or prompt development.
Do not execute scientific H2 episodes before Gates B, C, and the causal interlock are GO.
Do not upload raw restricted media by default.
Do not weaken construct, rights, source-group, or competence thresholds to fill quotas.

work_packages.name: Migration restore and integrity
actions: Select the code license and publish the audited public snapshot.
Restore the repository on the new machine and create protected restricted storage.
Restore or reacquire only owner-approved source assets and revision-pinned model assets.
Verify all available 15-source media/index bindings and source/participant/production-lineage grouping.
Archive old execution authority as immutable evidence; generate fresh runtime plans and hashes.
acceptance: Public snapshot and migration-bundle checksums pass.
Restricted directories are 0700 and files are 0600 with no symlinks.
No old authorization state is executable.
Source and index identities match their manifests or are explicitly marked unavailable.
Untouched test roster has no semantic or model exposure.

work_packages.name: Construct-contract alignment
actions: Add explicit source_group_id and participant/production-lineage bindings to construct registries, assignments, samplers, packets, exposure ledgers, and importers.
Replace or version-map historical H2_HUMAN_ADJUDICATED_GOLD to H2_HUMAN_ADJUDICATED_SATURATION_AUDITED.
Implement a latest Gate-A/Gate-B evaluator covering all post-pivot source, event, modality, saturation, governance, and labor conditions.
Implement a completed-authoring to real construct-registry bridge.
Implement a completed Task194 audio-prescreen import CLI or unified importer.
Freeze reviewer calibration and qualification thresholds before reviewer training.
acceptance: All construct, prescreen, and packet focused tests pass.
Source-group alias, mirror, derivative, and participant-collision tamper tests fail closed.
Blank packets cannot be promoted.
The evaluator cannot return Gate-B GO if non-NOAA, event-centric, ambient/V+S+A, saturation-repair, governance, or labor conditions are missing.
Every Gate-A and Gate-B condition has a machine-verifiable field and evidence pointer.

work_packages.name: Freeze result-production infrastructure
actions: Create versioned schemas for Tables 1-7 and result figures.
Implement source-cluster bootstrap, source-level sign-flip tests, Holm correction, leave-one-source-out, invalid-run sensitivity, and all-SES/preferred-SES sensitivity.
Freeze denominator and missing-run audits.
Freeze qualitative-example selection before outcomes.
Create a claim-to-table-cell and table-cell-to-artifact ledger.
Run operating-characteristic simulations on development assumptions before test unlock.
acceptance: Synthetic fixtures reproduce every planned table and figure-data schema.
Independent analysis implementation agrees row-by-row on fixtures.
No scientific outcome is required to select metrics, denominators, or example rules.
The 30-source/12-test preferred plan and 20-source/8-test descriptive fallback are represented without ambiguity.

work_packages.name: Local-source human prescreen and selective source repair
actions: Complete source-uniform semantic A/V prescreen on approved local development sources.
Complete the audio-only to A/V to recurrence review sequence for audio-rich candidates.
Run a dedicated far-composition pass.
Measure whether defensible V+S, V+S+A, ambient, and far/multi-hop prospects exist.
Use selective new acquisition only if local sources cannot close the frozen profile.
acceptance: Every retained prospect has exact source identity, lineage, rights/annotation authority, privacy/component review, and source-time alignment.
At least two source-disjoint V+S prospects and two V+S+A prospects exist, or the corresponding paper strata are removed prospectively.
At least six coherent far/multi prospects exist for the Gate-A roster.
No candidate is accepted solely because of temporal distance or duplicated speech/visual routes.
stop_conditions: Required cells can be filled only by weakening source grouping, rights, modality, temporal, or blindness rules.
After 12 long source groups and four lineages, fewer than two triple-modal prospects survive.
After at least 20 far-composition attempts across at least ten source groups, fewer than five coherent far prospects survive.

work_packages.name: Gate-A input freeze
actions: Author substantive question, answer, atomic claims, exact evidence bounds, candidate SESs, shortcut ledger, alternative-route hypotheses, and intervention feasibility.
Freeze exactly six source groups, twelve candidate families, and two excluded calibrations.
Train and qualify at least eight unique reviewers.
Freeze 72 real role assignments, the source-exposure snapshot, packet hashes, and the independent Gate-A audit.
acceptance: Exactly two gate-defining candidates per source group.
No unresolved critical rights, privacy, safety, lineage, construct, or technical hold.
Every required source-level and family-level semantic prescreen passes.
All intervention-v2 family manifests and route feasibility checks pass.
Gate A is independently adjudicated GO before packet distribution.

work_packages.name: Gate-B twelve-family construct pilot
actions: Run author/verifier, blind full-source alternative search, validators A/B, independent adjudication, and blind post-adjudication saturation in the frozen order.
Reopen every family with a newly discovered sufficient route.
Import all forms and run the independent latest Gate-B evaluator.
Report agreement, labor, route discovery, minimality, modality, pair isolation, governance, and rejection reasons.
acceptance: 12/12 families complete.
Pair-isolation failures <= 1/12.
Systematic minimality/modality failures <= 3/12.
At least two accepted non-NOAA source groups.
At least three accepted event-centric source groups or the broad claim is removed.
Ambient and V+S+A H2 coverage or those strata are removed before scientific execution.
All saturation discoveries are repaired and re-audited.
Measured yield and labor support unchanged-criteria scale-up.

work_packages.name: New Gate-C learned-system competence
actions: Freeze a provider-neutral controller/state/finalizer runtime and exact model bindings.
Permit separately bound controller and finalizer backbones while retaining an integrated system verdict.
Author and seal a new source-free unseen fictional suite with at least 48 cases.
Evaluate direct A/V, single-shot RAG, learned ReAct, learned sufficiency, finalizer, and integrated behavior.
Seal raw outputs before evaluation and conduct independent replay and competence audit.
acceptance: Parser and failure fixtures = 100%.
Valid structured calls >= 90%.
First-action accuracy >= 85%.
Every action stratum >= 75%.
Exact six-field state >= 75%.
Every state component >= 80%.
Complete-evidence supported answer >= 80%.
Blocked/partial correct non-answer >= 80%.
Restoration reacquisition >= 80%.
Unsupported required claims = 0.
Evaluator-private exposures = 0.
Deterministic answer/citation substitutions = 0.
Failure injection fail-closed = 100%.
non_reuse: Do not reuse consumed Granite v2, Qwen3 v2, Qwen2.5-Omni v1, or external-gateway v1/v2 holdouts as unseen competence.

work_packages.name: Low-N H2 Acquire/Ground/Act diagnostic
actions: Freeze the accepted H2 mini-pilot, systems, retrieval, prompts, budgets, metrics, seeds, and assignments.
Run direct A/V, learned RAG, learned ReAct, and learned sufficiency over CLEAN/BLOCKED/RESTORED/NO_TRIGGER.
Run silent withholding and explicit outage separately.
Run oracle-H2, partial-evidence, deterministic controls, observed-evidence-lock, and F-CTRL/F-VA sensitivity.
Independently replay and recompute all gate-driving metrics.
acceptance: At least one intervention-aware separation across at least three source groups.
At least one answer-versus-support or citation divergence.
At least two non-retrieval failure classes, each across at least two sources.
Complete invalid, missing, retry, cost, and source-denominator accounting.
No headline result is driven by one family or source.
Leakage, route-certificate, replay, and metric audits pass.

work_packages.name: Source-disjoint scale-up and final corpus
actions: Authorize the first forty scaled reviews only after a Gate-D GO and capacity review.
Continue only if H2 yield remains at least 60% without weakening criteria.
Freeze whole-source train/dev/test assignments and blind reserves before test construction.
Reach the preferred 60-H2/30-source/12-test corpus or invoke the restricted 60/20/8 descriptive fallback.
preferred_acceptance: Each paper-facing stratum has at least five untouched test sources.
fallback_acceptance: All controller-superiority, population-ranking, and broad-generalization claims are removed.

work_packages.name: Frozen main evaluation, independent audit, and paper package
actions: Execute the preregistered main matrix once on the frozen split.
Generate corpus, construct, competence, primary dashboard, matched-effect, failure-stage, and ablation tables from frozen scripts.
Run independent raw-trajectory metric and statistical recomputation.
Map every table cell and abstract/conclusion sentence to an audited artifact.
Complete rights, release, novelty, null/adverse result, and reproducibility audits.
Produce the versioned evaluator, benchmark card, sanitized examples, aggregate results, table/figure commands, and artifact appendix.
acceptance: All main claims have sentence-level evidence and gate mappings.
Every assigned run, failure, retry, exclusion, and denominator is reconciled.
Independent metric and statistical implementations agree within frozen tolerances.
Public release contents exactly match item-level rights decisions.
PAPER_CLAIM_READY is independently adjudicated GO.

lower_priority_until_h2_exists: Full manuscript Results, Abstract, or Conclusion

owner_inputs_required_before_resume: Approved repository code license and exact text.
GitHub organization, repository name, visibility, default branch, and secure credential method.
Hugging Face organization and approved public/private repository IDs.
New-machine root, OS, GPU inventory, driver/CUDA constraints, and protected restricted-data volume.
Item-level decision on whether any private derived indexes may migrate.
Rights and annotation-authority decisions for candidate sources.
Reviewer recruitment and pseudonymous identity-management plan.
